newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil premiums slide amid slack buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil premiums slide amid slack buying.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums weakened on Thursday, as the prospect of good supplies coupled with mild weather kept the few buyers around optimistic of lower numbers.
March IPE gas oil was down $3.25 a tonne to $181.25 at 1315 GMT reflecting yesterday's late losses on NYMEX heating oil.

Physical barges were slow with premiums lower. Traders said second half February Rotterdam refinery material was around March IPE +$5.50 fob Rotterdam, down 50 cents, with first half March at March IPE +$1.50-2.00.
Russian cargoes were heard offered as high as March IPE +$7, but several traders said this was too high.
Bids for second half February material were put at March IPE +$3-4 cif NWE.

Some dealers thought there was a touch more demand for heating oil into Germany with DIN attracting $1-2 above FOD quotes which were pegged about 50 cents lower at March IPE +$5.50-6.50 cif NWE for second half Feb.
Diesel was although the spread between sellers, who were around March IPE +$19-20 cif NWE, and buyers, as low as March IPE +$16 has widened.
